summary: Iteration 16 (frontend-only) verified the ProgressSlider lag fix and the 'Powered by OnSpace AI · GPT-5' removal on the public preview (375x667). BUG A (slider) - FIX WORKS on real touch input: CDP touch-drag on the 'Current Progress' track tracked live (1%->12->18->24->30->36->42->48->54->60% across 10 move samples) and committed exactly 60% on release; second drag committed 65%; tap-to-set snapped to 25% and 90%. Code review confirms parent onChange(setProgress) fires ONLY in endDrag (onResponderRelease/Terminate, vision.tsx:105-110,138-139); move frames only update local dragVal (shown = dragVal ?? value drives % text, fill width, thumb). Save flow: vision saved at 65% shows 'TEST Persist Check | 65%' card and PERSISTS across in-session reload (@hera_vision AsyncStorage). Regression PASS: masonry grid renders (4 seeded visions), modal opens via + and closes via Cancel, title/category fields work. BUG B (chat) - PASS: from Home, manifest input submit -> router.push('/(tabs)/chat') renders the chat screen; 'Powered by' has 0 DOM occurrences before/during/after AI replies and 0 code occurrences app-wide (only a boilerplate code comment in +not-found.tsx). Chat regression PASS: initial message auto-sent and Hera AI replied (streamed); a follow-up sent via the send button also got an AI reply; premium user correctly sees no count bar. TWO NEW SAME-CLASS REACT BUGS FOUND: both screens log 'Cannot update X while rendering Y' (shown in dev LogBox banner): (1) vision.tsx:105-110 endDrag calls parent onChange INSIDE the setDragVal updater; (2) chat.tsx:169-172 addMessage(HeraProvider) called INSIDE the setStreamingText updater after streaming completes. Values still commit, but side effects inside setState updaters are a React violation (can double-invoke/drop in concurrent mode) and surface a visible error banner in dev builds. All TEST data cleaned from localStorage (note: values are DOUBLE JSON-stringified via the raw adapter -> storage.setItem).

ui_bugs.issue: onChange(prev) is called INSIDE the setDragVal updater (side effect during render) -> React error 'Cannot update VisionFormModal while rendering ProgressSlider' on every release/tap; shown in LogBox banner on web dev. Value still commits correctly. Fix: mirror dragVal in a ref (or read state before clearing) and call onChange AFTER setDragVal(null), outside the updater. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/vision.tsx:105-110

addMessage (HeraProvider state) called INSIDE the setStreamingText updater after stream completes -> React error 'Cannot update HeraProvider while rendering ChatScreen' on every AI reply. Reply still saves. Fix: capture accumulated text in a local var/ref, then call addMessage after setStreamingText(''). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:169-172

MOUSE drag does not track moves on web (value stays at grant point until release) because react-native-web's responder system routes touch moves, not mouse drags. TOUCH drag works perfectly (verified via CDP touch events). Device behavior unaffected; desktop-web only. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/vision.tsx:125-141

react_native_issues.issue: Side effects (parent setState) inside setState updater functions - React anti-pattern causing 'Cannot update while rendering' errors. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/vision.tsx:105-110 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:169-172

No testID props on + button, Cancel/Save buttons, slider track, chat send button - automation relies on exact text, coordinates and DOM heuristics. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/vision.tsx:790,523-544; /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:299-314

action_items: FIX (HIGH): vision.tsx:105-110 - move onChange(prev) out of the setDragVal updater; use a dragValRef mirror: on endDrag read ref, clear ref+state, then call onChange. Eliminates 'Cannot update VisionFormModal while rendering ProgressSlider'.

FIX (HIGH): chat.tsx:169-172 - same anti-pattern; keep accumulated stream text in a local variable, call setStreamingText('') then addMessage(...) outside any updater. Eliminates 'Cannot update HeraProvider while rendering ChatScreen'.
Optional (web only): if desktop web drag matters, add pointer-event handling to the slider; on device touch it already works.
Optional: add testID props to vision modal buttons/slider and chat send button.
critical_code_review_comments: Slider fix architecture is CORRECT: dragVal local state, shown = dragVal ?? value drives % text/fill/thumb (vision.tsx:84-85,121,149,112-115); parent setProgress called once per gesture in endDrag on release/terminate only (vision.tsx:138-139). The lag fix intent is achieved - verified live with 10 in-drag samples updating smoothly without touching parent form state.

However endDrag's implementation (setDragVal(prev => { if (prev!==null) onChange(prev); return null; })) performs the parent update inside the updater - this is why React throws. Same defect independently exists in chat.tsx send() finalization. Both are one-pattern fixes.

'Powered by OnSpace AI · GPT-5' fully removed: chat.tsx is now 328 lines ending at the countBar block; grep app-wide finds zero 'poweredBy' style references and zero rendered 'Powered by' strings (only a harmless template comment in +not-found.tsx:5).

Vision persistence verified: HeraContext persists visionItems to @hera_vision on every change (contexts/HeraContext.tsx:252); saved card survived full page reload in-session. Earlier 'not persisted' observation was a fresh-browser-context artifact of the automation tool.

Deep-linking /(tabs)/vision redirects home - click tab bar coords at 375x667: home=(76,608), vision=(187,608); + add button=(346,41). Slider track: find leaf div 'Achieved!' -> parent.parent -> child with style.height==='44px'. DRAG MUST use CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent (touchStart/touchMove/touchEnd) - mouse drag does NOT move RN-web responder. Taps work with mouse.click. Chat input is a multiline <textarea> - Enter does NOT submit on web; click the send circle right of the textarea. localStorage @hera_* values are DOUBLE JSON-stringified. Verify the 2 setState-in-render fixes by watching console for 'Cannot update' errors during slider release and AI reply completion.
rca_of_issue: BUG A (slider lag) - original root cause: per-move parent setProgress re-rendered the whole modal. E1's fix (local dragVal + commit-on-release) is verified working on touch: smooth 10-sample live tracking, exact commit on release, tap-to-set works, persistence works. REMAINING DEFECT introduced/kept by the fix: endDrag calls onChange inside the setDragVal updater (vision.tsx:105-110) -> React 'setState during render' error banner; same pattern exists in chat.tsx:169-172 (addMessage inside setStreamingText updater). Mitigation: mirror the value in a ref and notify the parent after the state update, outside the updater. BUG B ('Powered by' line) - verified fully removed in code and in the live DOM across all chat states.
